metadata.description: Four Claude Code mods: qhud, pinboard, agent-flow, qcompact

plugins.name: qhud
plugins.description: Session status lines (renamed from tcw): model, effort and fallback chain, git status, context fill and usage limits (5h / weekly / per-model weekly), under or above the prompt

plugins.name: agent-flow
plugins.description: A pane (/aflow) with the main agent and every subagent: status, model, tokens, tool calls, what each is doing now with slow/thinking/silent signs, [+] details, unlisted loops, main_Diff / sub_Diff; /aflow stats sums the logged runs by agent and model

plugins.name: pinboard
plugins.description: Pinned notes above the prompt: /pin a note (! important, !! interrupt Claude), check it off or remove it with ×; each new pin reaches Claude at once; kept per folder; what you type is listed for the session

plugins.name: qcompact
plugins.description: A [Compact] button above the prompt: press it twice within 5 seconds to run the built-in /compact
